title: PES 0110 objects with owner-drawn programmable-fill and motif patterns read and written back
description: Three PE-DESIGN 11.50 files of one rectangle whose region or line uses a pattern the owner drew in Programmable Stitch Creator (a V tile as .pas, a V motif as .pmf; both in compat/reference/pes): programmable fill, motif fill and a motif line. Each is read by OpenStitch and written again; the stitches and colours survive. Issue #120 (object-kind fixtures: these were the kinds missing from the round-3 set, which has satin, fill, running, text and applique) and issue #131 (the .pas/.pmf grammar: @VERSION 10000, @SYSENV 1, @TILE 1, @TILELINE 0 3 x y..., @LINE 3 x y... in a 0..1024 cell).

evidence.note: compat/reference/pes/owner-v.pas and owner-v.pmf (PE-DESIGN 11.50 Programmable Stitch Creator, 2026-10-29): 72 and 61 bytes of ASCII, CRLF, the directives above; Default Size 7.5 mm
compat/reference/pes/obj-*.pes: 641, 144 and 47 stitches for the 30 x 20 mm rectangle
